# FreeResumePost

> FreeResumePost is a free resume-posting and profile-management tool for nurses and allied health professionals in the United States.

Users add a PDF or DOCX resume. The file is read in the browser first so the user can review the extracted details. The resume file and approved profile data upload only after the user taps Save.

## Connected job tool

- [Browse nursing and allied health jobs](https://freejobpost.co/jobs): FreeJobPost lists current roles posted directly by employers
- FreeJobPost and FreeResumePost are connected navigation tools. Moving between the sites does not transfer a resume, submit an application, or create an automatic match.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://www.freeresumepost.co): Product overview
- [Upload a resume](https://www.freeresumepost.co/upload): Browser-first PDF or DOCX resume flow
- [How it works](https://www.freeresumepost.co/how-it-works): Upload, review, visibility, and profile access details
- [Open a profile](https://www.freeresumepost.co/candidate/login): Email-verified access to an existing profile
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.freeresumepost.co/privacy): Data handling and deletion requests
- [Terms of Use](https://www.freeresumepost.co/terms): Service terms

## Product scope

- FreeResumePost focuses on nursing and allied health resumes.
- Profiles are private by default.
- A user can turn on a limited public link and turn it off again.
- A public link hides the user's email, phone number, full last name, and resume file.
- Public profile pages only render active profiles created through the FreeResumePost upload flow with public visibility turned on.
- FreeResumePost does not list jobs or submit job applications.
- FreeResumePost does not sell resume or contact data.

## Indexing

- [Sitemap](https://www.freeresumepost.co/sitemap.xml): Home, upload, how it works, privacy, and terms
- Public profile URLs follow `/profile/<slug>` and are excluded from the sitemap.
- Public profile pages use `noindex` and are intended for direct sharing.
